style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, soft blush pink #F9E7E7 for infographic and closing shots, light grey marble #EDEBE8 only for the benefit hero
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and small leaf motifs in the accent color #E85D5D only
style.lightingSystem: soft warm studio light with a gentle top key, soft fill, soft contact shadows; juicy translucent food texture, never harsh speculars, never plastic
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh juicy produce ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft blush pink #F9E7E7, charcoal text #4A4A4A and one vivid fruit-flesh red accent #E85D5D; warm soft studio lighting with a gentle top key, soft fill and soft contact shadows, food always looks juicy and translucent, never plastic; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only in charcoal #4A4A4A; consistent rounded info labels and thin-line leaf icons in the accent color #E85D5D; clean appetizing food photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable hero angle for the whole fruit plus one cut-open half across the set; fruit always fresh, intact skin, no bruising
style.surfaceSystem: light grey marble slab #EDEBE8 and warm wood tabletop #C9A98A, plus seamless studio sweeps
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only, charcoal #4A4A4A
